errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. The order is 'Ниско' (Low), 'Средно' (Medium), 'Високо' (High), 'Много високо' (Very High), which is a logical progression, not an alphabetical one.

The description incorrectly attributes the color 'светлосиньо' (light blue) to the year 2014. According to the legend and the bars, the lightest blue color corresponds to the year 2016, while 2014 is a medium shade of blue.
